new.title: Submit Change
new.description: Pick a review flow your permission groups grant and create a draft; stage datasources, reviewers and executors are frozen by the flow template.
new.empty: No review flow is granted to your account yet. Please contact an administrator.
new.flowCardDescription: Review flow: the stage chain is frozen by the template

dialog.title: Create review draft
dialog.description: Stage datasources, reviewers and executors of flow “{{flow}}” are frozen and read-only.

workspace.title: Precheck Workspace
workspace.flowFrozen: Flow information comes from the granted template and cannot be changed here before submission.

review.title: Review progress
review.description: Progress and conclusions come from the server-side review run.
review.noRun: No precheck yet. Click “Run AI precheck” to start.
review.timeout: The precheck has not finished within the expected window. Refresh later; contact an administrator if it stays stuck.

evidence.title: Review evidence
evidence.description: Normalized facts always show; raw data needs an explicit audited decrypt.
evidence.empty: No evidence is linked to this finding.
evidence.retention: Raw payload retention: about {{days}} days left. Only normalized evidence remains afterwards.

gate.high_severity_finding: A high severity finding forbids submission
gate.critical_severity_finding: A critical severity finding forbids submission

blocked.flowUpdated: The flow template changed: reload the template and re-run every stage precheck.
blocked.submitted: The draft has been submitted as a work order.
blocked.unsaved: There are unsaved SQL changes. Save the SQL first.
blocked.gate: Submission is blocked by the review gate
blocked.outdated: The review was frozen on an older draft revision. Run the precheck again.

submit.ready: Review is complete and submission is unlocked.
submit.successDescription: Work order {{number}} has been created; the review result is frozen as the submission snapshot.
submit.confirmDescription: Submitting freezes the flow, stages, review snapshot and SQL revision; this draft can no longer be modified.
submit.confirmGatePassed: All stage reviews passed; the backend still re-validates inside the transaction.
submit.confirmGateFailed: The gate is failing; the backend would reject this submission.

flowUpdated.title: Flow template updated
flowUpdated.description: The current review ran on the old template. Re-run every stage precheck before submitting.
flowUpdated.banner: The flow template changed; this review result is void.

failure.provider_unavailable: The AI service is unavailable. The review failed; retry later.
failure.budget_exhausted: The daily AI budget is exhausted. The review is incomplete; retry tomorrow or contact an administrator.

import.title: Import bulk SQL
import.description: Reads a local SQL file incrementally and builds a statement digest; the 32 MiB file and 512 KiB per-statement limits are pre-checked locally — the server result remains the final judgement.
import.pickHint: Pick a .sql or .txt file, or paste content into the editor
import.limitsHint: Limits: file 32 MiB · statement 512 KiB · 100,000 statements
import.cancelledDescription: Reading was aborted; the draft content is unchanged.
import.truncatedDescription: The file may be truncated; the server may treat this as a parse failure.
import.okDescription: On confirm the SQL content is uploaded in a single request.

fileTooLarge.title: File exceeds the 32 MiB limit
fileTooLarge.description: Actual {{actual}} bytes, limit {{limit}} bytes. Split the file and import in batches.

statementTooLarge.title: Statements above the 512 KiB limit found
statementTooLarge.description: {{count}} oversized statements (e.g. statement #{{samples}}), largest {{actual}} bytes, limit {{limit}} bytes. Split the statement.

tooManyStatements.title: More than 100,000 statements
tooManyStatements.description: Actual {{actual}} statements, limit {{limit}}. Split by table or statement range into multiple drafts.

browser.emptyDescription: Import a SQL file or load the SQL content to browse shape groups and statements in a virtualized list.
browser.localNote: Grouping is a browser-side shape digest for navigation only; the authoritative fingerprint grouping comes from the server review.
browser.revealFirst: The draft has SQL that is not loaded yet: use “Load SQL” to build the browsing digest.

capacity.warningDescription: A high fingerprint count means the model must review more representative samples — expect longer precheck duration and higher token usage.
capacity.splitTitle: Split recommended: {{count}} unique fingerprints exceed the {{limit}} limit
capacity.splitDescription: Split the SQL by table, schema or statement range so each draft stays within {{warning}} unique fingerprints, otherwise the review cannot complete.

list.title: My Orders
list.description: Drafts and submitted change orders are listed separately; query orders come with the query domain.
list.queryTabPending: The unified query-order view is delivered by the query-domain package (F10).
list.draftsEmpty: No drafts yet. Pick a flow from "Submit order" to start.

filter.emptyFiltered: No orders match the current filters.

detail.title: Order detail
detail.frozenNote: Revision, flow and review snapshot are immutable after submission; SQL plaintext requires an explicit audited reveal.
detail.withdrawDescription: The current stage has not started executing; the order terminates as "Withdrawn". Frozen actors and existing records are kept.
detail.withdrawPartialDescription: A stage already started executing or the result is unknown; the withdrawal is recorded as "Withdrawn after partial execution".
detail.voidDescription: Voiding terminates every step that has not executed; completed approvals and executions are retained and never rolled back.
detail.partialWarningTitle: Applied changes cannot roll back automatically
detail.partialWarningDescription: A prior stage executed successfully or its result is unknown. After withdrawal the state becomes "Withdrawn after partial execution"; applied database changes stay and need manual remediation.
detail.invalidDescription: Frozen reviewers were removed; this order can no longer be approved. Only the submitter may void it.
detail.frozenReviewNote: The findings below come from the review snapshot frozen at submission; the approval stage never re-runs the AI review.

sql.title: Frozen SQL revision
sql.revealNote: Plaintext requires an explicit reveal, is watermarked with the viewer identity and stays valid for 5 minutes; every reveal and copy is audited.

queue.title: Awaiting my decision
queue.frozenNote: Approvals reuse the review snapshot frozen at submission; neither this page nor any approval action re-runs the AI review.

decision.frozenReviewNote: Judge against the frozen review snapshot from submission and the SQL shown on this page.
decision.approveDescription: Approval advances the flow stage by stage; after the final step the order enters execution-pending and is executed separately by the frozen executor — never automatically.
decision.rejectDescription: A rejection by any reviewer immediately rejects the whole order; all remaining steps are voided. This cannot be undone.
decision.commentLabel: Comment (optional, written to the approval timeline)
decision.conflictHint: The page was refreshed to the latest state; please check it and retry.
